# MeedyaDL 1.11.0-alpha.21

Very early, hidden Spotify downloading has landed — reachable only through the secret developer-access mode, with safety guardrails built in from day one.

### What's new

- **Early Spotify downloading, hidden behind developer access.** MeedyaDL can now technically download from Spotify links, but this is very early and only reachable through the same hidden developer-access unlock used for early release channels — most people won't see any change. Before anything downloads, a one-time warning screen explains the risk to the Spotify account being used, and built-in safety measures (a daily download limit, and pacing between tracks) aim to reduce the chance of that account being flagged or restricted. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/101))

### Notes

- Spotify support is experimental and off by default for everyone except developer-access users. It will roll out more broadly in later releases as it's hardened.
- This is a pre-release on the **alpha** channel — early access to work in progress. The in-app updater serves the latest stable unless you've opted into Alpha.
